name: The Exact Pebble
method: Retained generated ochre/charcoal stick and chalk pebble pigment on bare stone. Original texture remains under pigment. Every pixel outside the bounded addition is original.
visual_review: Final full PNG and decoded 512-pixel JPEG visually inspected; no known unmet visual requirements.
hands: No visible hands or handprints; no digits to count.
prohibited_content: No text, letters, numbers, captions, signatures, logos, watermarks, borders, frames, real people or prohibited symbols observed.
preserved: Every ancestor painting is outside the insertion region and remains pixel-identical. Original canvas dimensions, warm rock, cracks, torchlight, water and framing retained.
